title: finish_message_delivery advances state counter before verifying UPDATE affected rows
description: finish_message_delivery calls advance_state_counter_in_tx before executing UPDATE messages SET delivery_state. The return value (affected rows) is discarded. If the message row does not exist (e.g. deleted in a TOCTOU window between outbox_tick loading the message and calling complete_delivery), the state counter still advances, creating a hole in the state_version sequence. Phase 1 has no message deletion API so this cannot trigger today, but it is a latent correctness bug for Phase 2 when deletion is added. update_delivery_state correctly checks affected rows and rolls back on 0; finish_message_delivery should do the same.
